title: The Thornwood Lodge
objective: Get past Captain Hesk's beasts into the old hunting lodge, take what you can from it, and leave by the forest gate.

rooms.name: Forest Gate
rooms.description: A sagging gate in the lodge's palisade, where a charcoal-burner has made camp beside a woodpile.

features.name: Woodpile
features.description: Split logs stacked against the palisade.
features.discovery: Behind the logs are a stoppered vial of red liquid and a shuttered lantern.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Hooded Lantern
items.description: A shuttered lantern with a wire handle.

creatures.name: Brann the Charcoal-burner
creatures.description: A soot-black charcoal-burner with a pack of goods to sell.

topics.name: the lodge
topics.reply: "Captain Hesk took the king's lodge when he quit the war. His hound runs the kennel yard, and a bear baits in the hall."

topics.name: the poachers' path
topics.reply: "Round the palisade to the left, there's a poachers' hide. They left in a hurry."

rooms.name: Poachers' Hide
rooms.description: A hide of woven branches under the palisade, smelling of old smoke.

features.name: Poachers' Cache
features.description: A sack hung from a branch, out of reach of foxes.
features.discovery: In the sack are a stoppered vial of red liquid and a pair of iron tongs.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Trapper's Tongs
items.description: Long iron tongs for springing traps.

rooms.name: Kennel Yard
rooms.description: A muddy yard ringed with kennels and strewn with gnawed antlers. A door leads into the lodge hall.

features.name: Hound's Kennel
features.description: The largest kennel, its straw matted flat.
features.discovery: Under the straw are a gilt hunting cup and a purse of gold.

items.name: Gilt Hunting Cup
items.description: A cup of gilt bronze chased with running deer.

rooms.name: Lodge Hall
rooms.description: A long feasting hall under a hammerbeam roof, its walls hung with antlers. A chain runs from a post to a churned-up bear pit, and a hatch in the floor leads down to the ice house.

features.name: Bear Pit
features.description: A pit of churned earth at the end of the chain.
features.discovery: Nothing but churned earth and bones.

features.name: Trophy Wall
features.description: Antlers, boar tusks and the king's old hunting shields crowd the wall.

failure-by-5.text: You tug at a shield and a rack of antlers crashes down on you.

failure.text: Dust and cobwebs, and nothing behind them you can see.

success.text: One shield bears no king's arms. Behind it, in a hollow in the wall, lies a jewel.

success-by-5.text: One shield bears no king's arms. Behind it, in a hollow in the wall, lie a jewel and a stoppered vial.

features.name: Ice-house Hatch
features.description: A heavy hatch in the hall floor, frozen shut over the ice-house steps.

failure.text: The ice holds the hatch fast.

success.text: The ice cracks and the hatch lifts onto the ice-house steps.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

rooms.name: Ice House
rooms.description: A domed ice house, half full of straw-packed ice. Something huge has made a nest in the back.

features.name: Owlbear's Nest
features.description: A nest of straw, feathers and bones.
features.discovery: Among the bones are a stoppered vial of red liquid and a cloudy green stone.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

rooms.name: Captain's Solar
rooms.description: A panelled room above the hall, warm from a banked fire. Captain Hesk's strongbox sits at the foot of a carved bed.

features.name: Hesk's Strongbox
features.description: An iron-bound strongbox with a broken lock.
features.discovery: Inside are a gold-chased hunting horn and a bag of gold.

items.name: Gold-chased Hunting Horn
items.description: An ivory hunting horn chased with gold, carved with the old king's hounds.

items.name: Captain Hesk's Coins
items.description: A heavy pouch of gold pieces.

passages.description: The path round the palisade to the kennels.
The poachers' path round the palisade.
The kennel door into the hall.
The steps down under the hatch.

trap.name: Man-trap
trap.description: Iron jaws hidden under the rushes on the gallery stair.
trap.trigger: Iron jaws slam shut on your leg.

opponents.name: Hesk's Hound
opponents.description: A dire wolf the size of a pony, wearing a studded war collar.

opponents.name: Baiting Bear
opponents.description: A scarred brown bear dragging a broken chain, mad with rage.

opponents.name: Captain Hesk
opponents.description: A grey deserter captain in splint armour, a greatsword held low and steady.

endings.title: Out with the spoils
endings.text: You leave the Thornwood by the forest gate with spoils from the captain's lodge.

endings.title: Out empty-handed
endings.text: You leave the Thornwood by the forest gate with nothing to show for it.

endings.title: Fallen in the Thornwood
endings.text: You fall in the Thornwood. Your adventuring ends here.
